task: Fix EPMCDME-16308: hook SSO auth gate now resolves the session launch profile (CODEMIE_PROFILE_CONFIG, else nearest ancestor .codemie config) via a new shared resolveHookAuthProfile() helper wired into the claude-code, copilot-chat and copilot-cli OTLP plugins.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: hook-auth-profile (new shared core helper), identity-fields (findNearestConfigDir export), claude-code-otlp plugin, copilot-chat-otlp plugin, copilot-cli-otlp plugin
component_scope.layers: Service (core hook helper), Agent-Tool (OTLP agent plugins)

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: SSO auth gate (authentication path) shared by three plugins, fail-closed semantics on config load errors, launch config JSON may carry credentials (log leakage), precedence between launch profile and local .codemie lookup
technical_risk.mitigation: Single shared helper with explicit precedence, fixed non-leaking log message for malformed CODEMIE_PROFILE_CONFIG (added in review fix-up), unit tests for the helper and for each plugin's gate wiring

key_reasoning.reason: A new shared core helper (hook-auth-profile) plus an exported lookup in identity-fields, consumed by three separate OTLP agent plugins. Red flags applied: touches shared core utility and affects multiple agents, bumping from M to L.

Touches the SSO authentication gate that blocks prompts and opens logins. Wrong profile resolution means blocking users or checking the wrong environment. Security-adjacent: the launch config can carry credentials, and a review fix-up was needed to stop malformed-config parse errors from being logged. Auth red flag bumped M to L.
9 files per diffstat (7 modified, 2 new including the helper's test) across src/agents/core and three plugin directories, with about 307 insertions, a majority of them tests.
